mapper.sql: id, run_uid, user_id, conversation_uid, message_uid, extractor_type, status, model, input_token_count, output_token_count, result_json, error_message, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_extraction_run ( run_uid, user_id, conversation_uid, message_uid, extractor_type, status, model, input_token_count, output_token_count, result_json, error_message ) VALUES ( #{runUid}, #{userId}, #{conversationUid}, #{messageUid}, #{extractorType}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'), #{model}, #{inputTokenCount}, #{outputTokenCount}, #{resultJson}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM learning_extraction_run WHERE run_uid = #{runUid} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_extraction_run SET status = 'processing', error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_uid = #{runUid}

UPDATE learning_extraction_run SET status = 'completed', model = #{model}, input_token_count = #{inputTokenCount}, output_token_count = #{outputTokenCount}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_uid = #{runUid}
UPDATE learning_extraction_run SET status = 'failed', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_uid = #{runUid}
